assertions.evidence: question.ts asks “Is this change breaking? Use only `pr.description` as evidence…”—it judges the change itself, not whether the text mentions breaking changes.
gate.ts hard-codes REVIEW_MIN = 0.25 and BREAKING_MIN = 0.75 and routeProbability uses these thresholds to pass/review/block.
In probes/results.json the “negation” case ('No breaking changes…') has noul 0.03, and the live CLI call printed probability 0.03 for that description.
